metadata.description: Primary references for evaluating agentic systems with offline and online evals, graders, trace and tool testing, sandboxing, multi-agent coordination, iterative coding trajectories, adversarial QA, red-team scanners, and agentic benchmark methodology.

evaluation_frameworks.name: Anthropic - Develop Tests

evaluation_frameworks.name: OpenAI - Agent Evals Guide

evaluation_frameworks.name: OpenAI - Trace Grading Guide

evaluation_frameworks.name: OpenAI Evals (GitHub)
evaluation_frameworks.description: Open-source package for automated evaluation harnesses. The hosted OpenAI Platform Evals UI is being shut down (read-only Oct 2026, shutdown Nov 2026). The open-source package and API remain functional. Verify current status before use.

evaluation_frameworks.name: DeepEval
evaluation_frameworks.description: Open-source LLM evaluation framework with agent, RAG, and pytest-style testing patterns. v4.0 (2026) adds agent-native evaluation: Task Completion, Tool Correctness, Step Efficiency, and Plan Quality metrics with @observe tracing integration.

evaluation_frameworks.name: DeepEval Docs
evaluation_frameworks.description: Official DeepEval documentation covering metrics, pytest integration, CI setup, and agent evaluation patterns including trace-based and full-trajectory metrics.

evaluation_frameworks.name: Braintrust
evaluation_frameworks.description: Commercial managed eval platform with experiment tracking, human-review queues, and SDK support for Python and TypeScript.

evaluation_frameworks.name: Langfuse
evaluation_frameworks.description: Open-source LLM observability and online eval platform; production tracing, cost tracking, session replay, and LLM-as-judge triggers on live traffic.

evaluation_frameworks.name: RAGAS Docs
evaluation_frameworks.description: Evaluation framework for RAG, agents, and tool or workflow behaviors.

evaluation_frameworks.name: HELM Benchmark
evaluation_frameworks.description: Benchmarking framework and evaluation dimensions for language models and systems.

tool_sandboxing.name: UK AISI Inspect Docs
tool_sandboxing.description: Official Inspect documentation for eval execution, sandboxes, and tooling.

tool_sandboxing.name: UK AISI Inspect Sandboxing Toolkit

tool_sandboxing.name: OpenAI - Building Agents Safely
tool_sandboxing.description: Current OpenAI safety guidance for approvals, isolation, and tool risk reduction.

tool_sandboxing.name: gVisor Documentation
tool_sandboxing.description: Sandbox runtime reference for isolated execution environments.

multi_agent_testing.name: Game-Theoretic Lens on LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
multi_agent_testing.description: Survey framing of multi-agent LLM systems and coordination issues.

multi_agent_testing.name: MultiAgentBench (MARBLE framework)
multi_agent_testing.description: Benchmark and framework (code name MARBLE) for evaluating collaboration and competition among LLM agents. "MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM Agents" (Kunlun Zhu et al., submitted March 2025, arXiv 2503.01935). Corrects a previous arXiv ID (2410.01078) in this file that resolved to an unrelated robotics paper.

llm_as_judge.name: Survey on LLM-as-a-Judge
llm_as_judge.description: Survey of biases, limitations, and mitigation patterns for model judges.

llm_as_judge.name: LangSmith Evaluation Docs

llm_as_judge.name: LangSmith Trajectory Evaluators
llm_as_judge.description: Guidance on evaluating agent trajectories, tool calls, and intermediate steps using the agentevals open-source package (langchain-ai/agentevals).

llm_as_judge.name: LangChain AgentEvals
llm_as_judge.description: Open-source package from LangChain providing trajectory match evaluators and LLM-judge evaluators for agent step sequences. Integrates with LangSmith for scoring and dataset management.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: Anthropic - Red Teaming Language Models
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Research on adversarial testing methodologies for language models.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: Promptfoo
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Prompt testing and evaluation tooling used for automated eval workflows.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: Promptfoo Red Team Docs
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Red-team workflows and attack-pattern guidance for LLM and agent systems.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: garak (NVIDIA LLM Vulnerability Scanner)
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Open-source LLM vulnerability scanner (Apache 2.0, maintained by NVIDIA), actively maintained as of 2026-07-11. Latest confirmed stable at last verification: v0.14.1 (April 2026), with v0.15.1.pre1 in pre-release (May 2026) — verify current stable version at release time rather than pinning to a specific number here. Recent versions have added agent-focused probes (multi-turn adversarial probes, tool-using-agent probes, system-prompt-extraction). Runs batch probes across promptinject, DAN jailbreaks, encoding bypass, data replay, and malware generation families. Use as a pre-release gate or nightly adversarial coverage scan.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: garak Docs
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Official garak documentation covering probes, detectors, and scanning workflows.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: PyRIT (Microsoft Python Risk Identification Tool)
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Open-source multi-turn adversarial orchestration framework for generative AI red teaming (MIT license, maintained by Microsoft AI Red Team). Coordinates LLM-powered attackers across turns using orchestrators, converters, and scorers. Supports single-turn, multi-turn, crescendo (gradually escalating), and TAP (Tree of Attacks with Pruning) orchestrators. Used on 100+ Microsoft products including Copilot (per Microsoft Security Blog — verify current figure). Note: the repo briefly lived at github.com/Azure/PyRIT; that mirror was archived March 27, 2026 and consolidated back into github.com/microsoft/PyRIT, which is the canonical repo as of 2026-07-11.

red_teaming_and_adversarial.name: PyRIT Docs
red_teaming_and_adversarial.description: Official PyRIT documentation covering orchestrators, targets, converters, and scorers.

research_and_benchmarks.name: SlopCodeBench: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Degrade Over Long-Horizon Iterative Tasks
research_and_benchmarks.description: March 2026 preprint introducing evolving-specification, carried-workspace checkpoints for iterative coding agents, with strict/isolated/core/regression correctness slices and longitudinal structural erosion, verbosity, cost, and duration signals. Reported experiments cover the Python track; the human repository panel is an unmatched calibration reference.

research_and_benchmarks.name: Constitutional AI
research_and_benchmarks.description: Reference for explicit safety principles and policy-oriented behavior.

research_and_benchmarks.name: TruthfulQA
research_and_benchmarks.description: Benchmark reference for truthfulness and hallucination-oriented tests.

research_and_benchmarks.name: τ-bench (Sierra Research)
research_and_benchmarks.description: Tool-Agent-User interaction benchmark: evaluates agents on multi-turn policy adherence and tool use via simulated user conversations. Introduces pass^k metric for reliability across k trials. Code at github.com/sierra-research/tau-bench.

research_and_benchmarks.name: τ²-bench (Sierra Research)
research_and_benchmarks.description: Dual-control agentic benchmark where both agent and user can invoke tools to modify shared world state (telecom domain). Exposes autonomous-vs-collaborative capability gap (~20pp drop). arXiv 2506.07982, June 2025. Code at github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench.

research_and_benchmarks.name: Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC)
research_and_benchmarks.description: Peer-reviewed methodology (arXiv 2507.02825, July 2025) for constructing and auditing agentic benchmarks across three categories: Task Validity, Outcome Validity, and Benchmark Reporting. Addresses systematic over/underestimation flaws (up to 100% in relative terms) found in widely-used benchmarks including SWE-bench and TAU-bench. Live checklist at uiuc-kang-lab.github.io/agentic-benchmarks/.

research_and_benchmarks.name: Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC) - Live Checklist
research_and_benchmarks.description: Interactive checklist for applying ABC task validity, outcome validity, and reporting criteria to any agentic benchmark.
